_comment: Phase 10 PropWire CSV field-mapping adapter. UNVALIDATED against a real PropWire export -- no sample file was available when this was written. Each key is one of this pipeline's own record fields; each value is a list of header spellings the importer will accept (first match wins, case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed). Send import_propwire.py --dump-headers <your.csv> to see what your actual file's headers are, and add the real spelling to the matching list below if it isn't already covered -- no code change needed.
_dedup_comment: Dedup uses this pipeline's own property_identity()/owner_identity() (parcel/RE# first, normalized address fallback) -- same mechanism the primary Duval Clerk scrape already uses -- so re-importing the same PropWire export twice does not create duplicate properties or owners.
_owner_type_comment: owner_type is authoritative when the CSV supplies it directly (values like 'Individual'/'Entity'/'Trust'/'Estate' are recognized case-insensitively); otherwise classify_owner_type() falls back to name-parsing the owner/co_owner fields.
